sacraments.text: Parish Office staff Lillian Ong handles sacraments; William Ng handles columbarium.

February 2026 application form: submit child birth certificate, parents civil/church marriage certificates, one parent baptism certificate, godparents baptism/confirmation certificates with ID verification. Godparents 16+, confirmed practising Catholics; one male or female or one of each, not child’s parents. Form lists$100 church contribution. Timing/preparation not stated; enquire sacramental office.

Application form requests birth certificate, civil/church marriage certificates if applicable, applicant/godparents ID/passport, godparents confirmation certificates. Form and minor-baptism consent form linked on Pastoral Service page.

Book at least 1 year ahead by email. Reservation held 1 week; both parties submit endorsed form in person, IDs verified and contribution paid within that week; request extension before expiry (one further week). Coordinator contacts couple 5–6 months ahead; one preparation meeting required. Saturday earliest 09:30;2nd/4th Saturdays 09:30/10:00, afternoon 13:00/13:30 only when morning unavailable. No wedding receptions in compound. Rehearsal max 1h without air-conditioning.
